description: This Java class 'FuelTunePane' provides a user interface for tuning fuel maps in an engine control system. It integrates with various external components for data collection, processing, and uploading, and contains logic for data visualization, auto-tuning iterations, and logging.

classes.name: FuelTunePane
classes.description: A Swing-based UI component for auto-tuning fuel maps in an engine control system, providing data collection, visualization, and upload functionality.

classes.name: FuelDataPoint
classes.description: A data class representing engine RPM, engine load, and AFR measurements collected for auto-tuning.

methods.name: uploadCurrentResult
methods.description: Uploads the current auto-tuned map to the controller and triggers table reload.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Populates a Table object from byte array content and offset.

methods.name: initTable
methods.description: Initializes Table3D objects with sizes, scales, and borders.

methods.name: doJob
methods.description: Runs auto-tune process on collected data, updates the map, and enables upload.

methods.name: writeDataPoints
methods.description: Logs collected AFR, RPM, and load data points.

methods.name: logMap
methods.description: Outputs a double matrix (map) to log.

methods.name: getTuneLogStream
methods.description: Creates or returns existing log stream for auto-tune logs.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D double array into a byte array in big-endian float format.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Sets up sensor listeners to collect data and loads VE tables into UI components.

methods.name: reloadVeTable
methods.description: Reloads VE table data from the controller content into internal structures.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads a 2D map from byte array with specified offset.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads a float array from controller data at specified offset.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main component of the UI.

methods.name: FuelDataPoint
methods.description: Represents a data point with RPM, engine load, and AFR values, including mapping to indices.
